g.title: Historical out-of-sample residual for fitting the available-power correction

g.aria-label: Normalized residual equals observed available power at t plus h minus its out-of-sample baseline, divided by the station scale.

g.aria-label: Absolute residual correction is at most alpha c times the station power scale.
g.title: Absolute residual correction is at most alpha c times the station power scale.

g.aria-label: Available-power output is bounded by the nonnegative baseline minus or plus the maximum correction.
g.title: Available-power output is bounded by the nonnegative baseline minus or plus the maximum correction.
